pages.text: The Crafting Monitor provides real-time information about all ongoing crafting tasks in your Refined Storage network. It displays a detailed list of tasks, showing their progress, required materials, and any missing resources. This interface is essential for managing complex crafting operations and troubleshooting issues that may arise during automated crafting.

The monitor categorizes tasks by status, allowing you to quickly identify:$(br)• Crafting tasks in progress$(br)• Scheduled tasks waiting to start$(br)• Blocked tasks missing resources$(br)• Completed tasks$(br)$(br)You can also cancel ongoing tasks or clear finished ones through this interface. For remote monitoring, consider using a Wireless Crafting Monitor to access this information from anywhere within range of your network.
